conversation.initialMessage: Build a small command-line expense tracker in Python (standard library only) that stores expenses in a local SQLite file: add an expense, list expenses, and show totals by category. Include tests.
turns: Add monthly budgets per category and a warning when a new expense exceeds the budget.
Change of plan: store data in a JSON file instead of SQLite, because the users can't install anything. Keep everything else working.
Write a README and tell me every design decision and constraint from this session.
